co_shadow.name: Stealth Missile Boat
co_shadow.model: Sea Shadow test ship (a fighting fit she never carried)

ao_provider.name: Replenishment Ship
ao_provider.model: Fort Victoria-class replenishment ship (oil and ammunition in one hull)

cg_thunder.name: Rail Gun Cruiser
cg_thunder.model: CG(X) cruiser (a paper design, never built)

tidewater.name: Tidewater Naval Shipbuilding
tidewater.desc: Hesperian seaboard yards building big, fast, heavily gunned ships in long series.

clydemouth.name: Calder & Wexmouth
clydemouth.desc: Old northern yards: well-armoured, seaworthy ships with conservative engineering.

ostsee.name: Strelsk-Werke
ostsee.desc: Vargan sound yards known for broad, stable hulls, high-pressure machinery and twin turrets.

neva.name: Korvagrad Admiralty Yards
neva.desc: Directorate state yards that took over the Strelsk drawings after the armistice and built on them.

seto.name: Amakura Naval Arsenal
seto.desc: Halcyon yards favouring speed, very heavy guns and long-range torpedoes on light hulls.

tirreno.name: Cantieri del Corvo
tirreno.desc: Cradle Sea yards building elegant, very fast ships that trade armour for speed.

marine.name: Combine Marine
marine.desc: The Meridian Combine's merchant yards: freighters and cheap, robust escorts.

concord.name: Hesperian Concord
concord.desc: The leading naval power of the Oceanic Entente. Professional, bureaucratic, and convinced that sea control is the only guarantee of civilization.

directorate.name: Vargan Directorate
directorate.desc: Authoritarian, industrial, and continental-minded. The Directorate believes the ocean powers strangled its rightful access to the world’s trade.

pacific.name: Halcyon Federation
pacific.desc: A maritime confederation of island states and trading cities in the Halcyon Ocean. Agile, commercially minded, and wary of both Concord and Directorate.

combine.name: Meridian Combine
combine.desc: A powerful corporate-state hybrid that controls the critical Lantern Strait and much of the eastern Monsoon Ocean trade. Officially neutral, ruthlessly pragmatic.

republic.name: Tarsene Free Republic
republic.desc: A young, ideologically fierce republic that seized control of the western side of the Tarsene Gate during the war’s chaotic final year.

freeport.name: Freeport Syndicate
freeport.desc: Not a state but a loose, heavily armed association of freeports, smugglers, privateers, and exiles.

enclave.name: Halvard Enclaves
enclave.desc: Hardy northern settlements and naval stations in the ice-fringed Rime and Skarn Passages. Traditionally neutral, isolationist, and respected for their seamanship and ice navigation.

ombria.name: Ombrian Protectorate
ombria.desc: The Directorate's client regime on the Ombrian shore of the Cradle Sea: a junta kept in power by Vargan advisers and Vargan guns, the southern half of the Continental Compact.

isles.name: Outer Isles League
isles.desc: The island states of the Oceanic Entente that never joined the Federation: small, proud, lightly armed, and loyal to whoever keeps the raiders off their reefs.

raiders.name: Black Flag raiders
raiders.desc: Pirates and deserters preying on everyone.
